entries.description: A UX defect fixed WITHOUT breaking the suite, after the browser suite caught a regression this session caused. The first attempt REMOVED the control; `e2e/record-drawer.spec.ts:219` then timed out on `getByTitle("Back to homepage")` — FOUR specs drive the exit-to-public-site path through that title (`access-gate:175`, `homepage-editor:77`, `onboarding-workflow:68`, `record-drawer:219`) and it is the only in-shell route back to the public site.
